campaign.title: Rename G40_10_PROVIDER while preserving identity and bindings.

initial.code:
FUNCTION G40_10_PROVIDER(X)
  G40_10_PROVIDER = X
  IF (X < 0) THEN
    G40_10_PROVIDER = 0
  END IF
  IF (X > 73) THEN
    G40_10_PROVIDER = 73
  END IF
  G40_10_PROVIDER = G40_10_PROVIDER
END FUNCTION
FUNCTION G40_10_PRED_1(X)
  G40_10_PRED_1 = 0
  IF (G40_10_PROVIDER(X) >= 27) THEN
    G40_10_PRED_1 = 1
  END IF
  G40_10_PRED_1 = G40_10_PRED_1
END FUNCTION
FUNCTION G40_10_PRED_2(X)
  G40_10_PRED_2 = 0
  IF (G40_10_PROVIDER(X) >= 28) THEN
    G40_10_PRED_2 = 1
  END IF
  G40_10_PRED_2 = G40_10_PRED_2
END FUNCTION
